sections.title: Confirm the supplier and the service being quoted
paragraphs:

Its [services page](https://answeringspecialists.com/services) explicitly includes HVAC, plumbing, electrical and construction businesses among its audiences. Employment listings for answering specialists do not establish the supplier's current purchase terms.

Begin with a fictional ordinary residential inquiry: the caller gives a name, callback number, service address and a description of the work. sections.title: Separate the entry plan from the prepaid-call package
paragraphs:
The [pricing page](https://answeringspecialists.com/pricing) lists Lite at $35 per month with 25 calls and name, number and message only. It describes Lite as an exception without add-ons or rollover. The Basic starting package is displayed at $80 with 50 prepaid calls; the page's calculation includes a $25 base fee. Do not add that base fee a second time to the displayed package total.

Those are published starting figures, not a complete quote. The same page distinguishes additional message fields from complex tasks charged by time. It also uses different descriptions of rollover duration. Obtain the applicable account terms rather than resolving those differences in your own forecast.

sections.title: Complete this task-to-charge worksheet
paragraphs:
Give the supplier your required outcome in the first column and request its written classification in the second. Leave unknown charges unresolved.

| Required office outcome | Classification to obtain | Evidence needed before buying |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Name, number and ordinary message | Selected reception package | Included call definition and any exclusions |
| Service address and project information | Included message or additional field | Which fields change the charge and when |
| Customer requests an appointment | Message capture or scheduling work | Whether a time is requested or a booking is confirmed |
| Office receives a new service ticket | Message delivery or ticket creation | Supported destination, permitted action and charge unit |
| A caller needs another language | Supported language handling or translation | Applicable arrangement and any separate cost |
| A quiet period leaves prepaid calls unused | Applicable rollover rule | Expiry date and effect of changing packages |
| A call exceeds routine intake | Retained office task or separately quoted work | Authorized next step and follow-up owner |

For example, receiving an email that says “please book Tuesday” is different from entering a confirmed appointment. Ask to see the actual resulting record. Do not price the two outcomes as equivalent simply because both begin with an answered call.

sections.title: Request a worked quote without inventing the total
paragraphs:
Use your own expected mix of ordinary messages and supported additional tasks. Ask the supplier to classify a sample call that collects an address and then requests scheduling. Which charges apply, and which do not? If a minimum applies to complex services, confirm whether it is shared across selected tasks or applies separately. The public wording alone does not settle every combination.

Keep the package commitment, usage increments, setup charges and any additional work visible in the written offer. Have the supplier state the rollover expiry date for that account. This worksheet is an evaluation resource, not a prediction of the invoice or a promise of savings.

The general [answering-service cost guide](/ai-answering-service/answering-service-cost) explains common billing models. Here the decision is narrower: which Answering Specialists task belongs to which quoted unit, and whether that task is necessary for your office.

sections.title: Compare Revo using the reception outcome you need
paragraphs:
Revo publishes AI answering, business-script intake, supported appointment booking and call summaries. Team transfers depend on the selected plan and supported configuration. Review [current Revo plans](/pricing) against the intake and follow-up your office can retain.

This guide does not establish that Revo supplies Answering Specialists' human receptionists, live translation, ticket creation or back-office services. If a contracted human or a particular system write is mandatory, verify that requirement directly. Compare demonstrated outcomes and retained work without treating different functions or billing units as interchangeable.

sections.title: Questions before choosing
paragraphs:
### Does a per-call headline cover every additional task?

Not by itself. Obtain the classification of each required field and action in the selected offer.

### Is Lite the same workflow as a larger package at a smaller allowance?

Do not assume that. Its published scope and add-on restrictions need to fit the actual information your office requires.

### Can I treat every search result about the company as a customer review?

No. Employment information and customer purchasing evidence serve different purposes. This guide evaluates public product documents and makes no customer-satisfaction rating.

[Review Revo's current plans](/pricing) with the completed worksheet and compare the supported reception result before choosing.
